answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake in escrow before it can transact, like a marble dropped into a shared vault: creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and the stake is slashed if the agent cheats. A public lantern of reputation, a signed auditable history of completed work, lets others verify an agent earned its standing rather than buying it, and an opal-like uniqueness check ties each stake to one verified attestation, so duplicates are visible and cheap to reject.
